value.rationale: The first overlap graph with an independent gauge-invariant phase (one cycle) has identical magnitudes in every phase, yet all noninteger positive Schatten moments strictly reverse their phase order at every integer below the cycle length. The theorem gives complete sharp phase envelopes, universal heterogeneous optimizer classes, and quantitative separation beyond qualitative phase detection. This is a natural operator-theoretic classification rather than an arbitrary finite calculation.
